summary: Frontend retest of the Guardian Journey custom-duration fix (baselineDurationRef). Ran on the Expo web preview at 375x667 as voicetest2026@example.com, with fake 900000000x numbers and window.open stubbed. PRIMARY BUG FIXED. I picked 30 min (shown as 12:53 → 01:23 PM), then typed 1441 into Custom one key at a time. The prefixes 1, 14 and 144 show briefly, which is expected because each is valid. The 4th key shows guardian-duration-error 'Choose between 1 and 1440 minutes.' and the check-in returns to 01:23 PM (30 min). All 3 Prepare buttons are aria-disabled, and a forced tap gave 0 POSTs and 0 sms links. Blurring clears the text and the error, re-enables Prepare and keeps 30 min. Typing 0 shows the error and keeps 30. Clearing with Backspace removes the error and keeps 30. VALID CUSTOM: typing 45 key by key gives tap+45 with no error and Prepare enabled. After blurring, typing 1441 falls back to 45, not 144. The prepared SMS reads 'check in by 01:38 PM' (tap 12:53:57 + 45). Head Out param durationMins=45 with '00' typed after it also falls back to 45. CHIPS: tapping 15 after 1441 clears the error and the Custom text, and 15 min is in force. Typing 1441 after that falls back to 15. OWNER BUG: a typed destination, 30 min and one Prepare tap made 1 POST and 1 sms: link with the destination and check-in at tap+30 (12:54:40 → 01:24 PM). An empty destination shows 'Enter a destination first.' and a forced tap did nothing. After the first Prepare the fields lock: guardian-fields-locked shows, both inputs are not editable and the chips are aria-disabled. REGRESSION, all passing: one SMS per contact on the same link (1 POST, 2 SMS); banner 'prepared for 2 people'; 112 blocked with the 'No message was prepared' error; 'Track my journey live' only with gpsLive=1; a revoked journey shows 'Sharing has ended' on /guardian/<token> for the in-app recipient with no area or coordinates leaked; the link-failure wording appears in both the create error/preview and the SMS body; mark-safe and withdraw network failures show Try again, and retrying succeeds. Silent Alert, /emergency (112 dialler), Family Journey, Evidence Locker (PIN setup) and Head Out (Places suggestions plus map) all load without a red screen. All created journeys and the circle link were revoked by id.
critical_code_review_comments: guardian-share.tsx onBlur reads durationMins and durError from the render closure. On native, if a chip's onPress fires before the Custom field's blur, the blur can write a stale durationMins into baselineDurationRef. The duration in force is not affected and the next onFocus re-snapshots the baseline, so this is harmless today. Reading from refs would make it airtight.
Still open as known (not retested): a stale withdraw error can stay after a later successful mark-safe.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Init script: /tmp/i93_init.js sets gk_token and gk_user. gk_lang must be the JSON string '"en"' or auth.tsx throws a red screen. It also sets lang_onboarded_v1_<uid>, ws_panic_lesson_seen and ws_trusted_circle_<uid>, and stubs window.open and fetch POST capture. Use page.context.add_init_script so popups and new pages get the stubs. Women's Shield → ws-tool-people-circle-outline opens guardian-share. Read the time from the text matching /Check-in by/. For the revoked guardian view, run test_it91_guardian_revoked_view.py (it creates the invite, accepts it as fir-test-user2, then revokes) and open /guardian/<token> logged in as the recipient. The owner gets 403 'Not authorized' by design.
